messages:
pagerduty: PAGERDUTY ALERT: P1 — spike in 5xx (gateway TLS handshake failures) across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Paging maya (oncall).
pagerduty: Symptoms: ~4.3% 5xx, majority TLS handshake errors and timeouts at the edge. First seen 2026-03-14T09:12:00Z.
ops-bot: Incident created: incident/2026-03-14-edge-tls-spike. Severity: P1. Runbook: /runbooks/tls-handshake-spike.md
maya (oncall): on it. confirming: any recent cert or rotator deploys in the last 6–12h?
liam (infra-sre): I see a config roll from the rotator job at 03:45 UTC — CA bundle updated for mTLS clients, message: "replace ca.pem". Deploy-bot shows successful rollout to edge-proxy groups 1/3 then errors on group 2 with 502s.
nora (eng-runtime): edge-proxy logs show repeated: \`TLS handshake error: remote error: tls: unknown certificate\` and \`tls: handshake timeout\`. Also some \`certificate signed by unknown authority\` for client cert validations.
jonah (eng-ml): metrics: latency spikes correlate with handshake failures, no upstream model pods failing. Suggests client->edge negotiation failing.
maya (oncall): confirmed customer-facing errors being reported (ops ticket queue, Slack signals). severity P1. Let's triage: 1) can we roll rotator back? 2) any safe traffic reroute? 3) temporary relax mTLS strictness?
liam (infra-sre): I'll check rotator job and the artifact — looks like the new CA bundle dropped the intermediate cert. Chain is incomplete, client cert chains fail validation on edge which does full client CA chain check.
liam (infra-sre): reproducing locally: openssl s_client -connect edge-eu:443 -CAfile /etc/edge/ca.pem  returns 
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
1399999999:error:14090086:SSL routines:ssl3_get_server_certificate:certificate verify failed:openssl/ssl/ssl_stat.c:xxx:verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
```

maya (oncall): ok — probable cause: rotator replaced CA bundle and omitted intermediate causing mTLS client cert validation to fail. Does rollback artifact exist?
deploy-bot: rollback available: rotator-config@2026.03.14-0340 — last-known-good present.
liam (infra-sre): I can start rollback to edge-proxy groups. Will patch group 2 first (failing one) and b/g to avoid total outage.
nora (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation: enable fallback TLS profile that accepts full certificate chains and validates against legacy CA for routes to critical customers. I can flip for a small subset (critical-cust route) now. This reduces risk while rollback proceeds.
maya (oncall): Do it. Add rate-limited fallback so we don't open the floodgates. Notify customer-ops for communication.
customer-ops: copying — preparing customer notice. We'll call top 10 affected customers after stabilization.
liam (infra-sre): Rolling rotator rollback to group 2 now. monitoring.
ops-bot: Deploy started: rotator-config rollback -> group: edge-eu-2 (id g-12).
(nine minutes pass)
liam (infra-sre): rollback applied to g-12. Observing handshake error rate drop from 4.3% -> 1.1% in that slice. Still seeing failures in group g-11. Rolling there next.
jonah (eng-ml): confirming model endpoints healthy; requests that do get through are fine. Means problem is at TLS termination.
maya (oncall): log snippets for capture for postmortem. Can someone grab rotator job logs and the exact CA bundle diff? We need to know why intermediate was dropped.
liam (infra-sre): attaching diffs in incident channel thread (copied here): old bundle had -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----...intermediate...-----END CERTIFICATE----- new bundle lacked that block. Likely bug in rotator merge step where it trimmed by regex.
nora (eng-runtime): mitigation checklist: 1) complete rollback across all edge groups (liam) 2) reconfigure rotator to validate full chain before promoting (jonah + liam) 3) reissue and re-deploy full-bundle with intermediate included (nora) 4) add smoke-tests that simulate client cert chain verification (nora)
maya (oncall): Are we comfortable telling customers root cause as "bad CA bundle rotation removed intermediate causing mTLS client cert validation failures"?
customer-ops: yes, that's accurate; will mention we rolled back and applied hotfix, ETA for full remediation 2 hours.
liam (infra-sre): rollback finished across all groups at 09:27:45Z. Global handshake failures back down to baseline ~0.2%.
ops-bot: Incident status: degraded -> mitigated. Pager duty: acknowledged.
maya (oncall): moving incident to recovery phase. Tasks: postmortem owner?
nora (eng-runtime): i'll own postmortem and remediation PRs.
maya (oncall): cool. Handoff to night oncall in 45m — leaving notes: root cause: rotator CA bundle merge bug dropped intermediate cert; impact: elevated 5xx (TLS handshake failures) for ~15 minutes for some edge groups, affecting ~4% of requests at peak and ~12 customers reporting errors; mitigation: immediate rollback of rotator config and temporary fallback for critical routes; permanent fix: add validation and smoke tests + fix rotator merge logic; followups: create customer comms summary and attach logs.
liam (infra-sre): follow-up action: add pre-deploy check that `openssl verify -CAfile <bundle> <client-cert>` succeeds for a canonical client chain.
jonah (eng-ml): also recommend adding canary rollouts by customer segment so critical customers don't hit a bad rotator code path.
maya (oncall): good. I'll update incident ticket and escalate to SEs for customer callbacks. Leaving thread and handing to night oncall @nova in 45m.
ops-bot: Handoff recorded: oncall maya -> nova at 10:12Z.
customer-ops: will post customer-facing summary in ~30m once we verify final metrics.
maya (oncall): thanks everyone. Postmortem assignee: nora. Severity: P1 -> will file retrospective and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
